DATA READING GUIDE

Check the context before comparing figures

These are time-stamped observations collected by this site, not official live population data.

Collection practices

Sample coverage

Only observed servers and players are included; do not treat the total as the full game population.

Activity status

Status is based on the last-seen record and does not mean the player is currently online.

Power distribution

Averages react to extreme values, so compare them with the median and percentile thresholds.

Reference time

Datasets update at different times. Check the date shown before making server comparisons.
